text.content:
Charges

Vagabond keeps bookkeeping low, so no item rolls to recover charges. Every charged item is 3 charges (wands, Ring of the Ram) or 5 charges (staffs, Abracadabrus), and they all come back in full after a Rest. Fixed-use items (Chime of Opening, Bag of Tricks, Necklace of Fireballs) were cut to 3–5 for the same reason.

Threat Level ≈ Challenge Rating

Every hand-converted creature was validated against Vagabond's own TL formula. TL is calibrated against the core compendium's scale rather than raw CR — core's Veteran is CR 3 at TL 2.4, and its Goblin is CR ¼ at TL 1.2 — so low-CR creatures naturally sit around TL 0.5–1.5.

Things Vagabond does not have

  • No Radiant or Force damage. Both are reflavoured as magical. Auril's radiant vulnerability became Fire; the potion of radiant resistance became the Potion of Warding.
  • No Necrotic or Psychic damage. Attacks that dealt them deal Magic damage; Immune lines still name them as a note for the GM.
  • No burrow speed. Burrowers (Remorhaz, Ice Piercer) describe it in an ability instead.
  • Small size means 1 HP per HD, and is reserved for rat-scale creatures. The Demilich and Flameskull are built Medium so they aren't crippled by it.
  • No boss HP doubling. Auril's forms and the Demilich reach their intended HP through a doubled effective HD instead.

Weather & cold

Roll Weather — The Everlasting Rime each dawn, and Blistering Cold — Exposure for anyone caught out without shelter or warmth. Cold Resistance items and the Ring of Warmth exist precisely to switch this off.

• Monsters — 207 stat blocks in eight sub-folders by Being Type.
  • NPCs — 229, split into Villains, Key NPCs, and one folder per chapter. 211 of them are named individuals built on a shared stat block; each one's sheet says which chassis it uses.
  • Magic Items — 67, in six folders (Bag of Holding, Helm of Telepathy, Potion of Cold Resistance, Potion of Gaseous Form, Potion of Healing, Potion of Invisibility, Potion of Superior Healing are left out: use the core Relics and Alchemical Items compendiums), priced from Vagabond's official Powers table.
  • Tables — six encounter tables by region, plus weather, cold exposure, scavenging and chwinga gifts.

Token dispositions

Monsters and Villains are Hostile. Key NPCs are Friendly. Everyone in a chapter folder defaults to Neutral, except the ones who are genuinely enemies (cultists, duergar, the Ythryn cast) — those are already set Hostile. Names show on hover: GM-only for monsters, everyone for NPCs.

Not included

No maps and no published adventure text — this module is stat blocks, items and reference only. You'll need the adventure itself to run it.
